description: Model registry (D15/D20, V4 F3). Each entry wraps an existing model behind the standard interface. declared_state is the intended state; the registry keeps a model 'validated' only if it both declares validated and passes the D20 promotion check (registry.meets_promotion_criteria). No new science: adapters are thin wrappers.
